mcp__literature_pdf__list_pdfs.description: List the task-selected PDFs and their frozen content versions; no relevance ranking.

mcp__literature_pdf__prepare_pdf.description: Prepare versioned page text and a navigation index; low-text pages need inspection, not automatic OCR.

mcp__literature_pdf__search_pdf_text.description: Find literal words across all extracted pages; snippets are navigation, not verified evidence.

mcp__literature_pdf__pin_pdf_context.description: Bind an explicitly selected physical page text window to the PDF and parser versions.

mcp__literature_pdf__read_pinned_pdf_con.description: Read only a service-issued PDF window; reject changed content and expose continuation offsets.

mcp__literature_pdf__preview_research_no.description: Validate a complete per-paper draft against read source windows and render notes; no claim entailment or user-file writes.

mcp__literature_pdf__read_pdf_evidence_p.description: Execute selected coverage once; normalize overlap and page ends, replay source guards.
